newsitem.title: USA: Energen to buy Burlington reserves.
newsitem.headline: Energen to buy Burlington reserves.

text.p: Energen Corp said Tuesday it has agreed to purchase some 225 billion cubic feet equivalent of oil and high BTU content natural gas reserves in the San Juan Basin from Burlington Resources Inc for $77,750,000.
These properties are part of Houston-based Burlington Resources's accelerated divestiture program, Energen said. Closing is expected in March with a January 1 effective date.
The company said its subsidiary, Taurus Exploration Inc, plans to operate half of the about 1,750 producing wells. Some 80 percent of the reserves are developed and producing.

Taurus plans to spend an additional $18.5 million to fully develop these long-lived, predominantly natural gas reserves, Energen said. "While these properties contain primarily proved developed producing reserves, we believe there is good upside potential from behind-pipe recompletions and stimulations as well as from development drilling," said Taurus Chief Operating Officer James McManus.
Resulting production from this acquisition is expected to exceed seven billion cubic feet equivalent for Taurus in fiscal 1997, ending September 30 and nine billion cubic feet in 1998.
